title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E01 — Opening Night
Three months after freeing Santanico from the Titty Twister, the Gecko Brothers are still on the run; Seth and Kate are lost in Mexico; Richie and Santanico plot vengeance on the culebra Lord.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E02 — In a Dark Time
Seth and Kate pull off a heist; Ranger Gonzalez confronts nightmarish visions; Carlos's emergence from the Labyrinth.

title: Blown Away
description: An Irish explosive expert targets an old foe and his family living in Boston.

title: Walking Tall: The Payback
description: A man (Kevin Sorbo) discovers a link between the mysterious death of his father and a gang of murderous thugs.

title: Contract Killer
description: A fast talker (Eric Tsang) engages a Hong Kong rube (Jet Li) to track down the assassin of a sleazy Japanese businessman.

title: Empire State
description: A security guard (Liam Hemsworth) and his childhood pal (Michael Angarano) make plans to rob an armored car.

title: Dangerous
description: An ex-con and reformed sociopath battles a band of heavily armed mercenaries as he tries to uncover the truth behind his brother's mysterious death.

title: Redemption
description: Joey, an alcoholic war veteran assumes a new identity after returning from a traumatic tour in Afghanistan and becomes a vigilante in a bid to atone for his sins.

title: Chaos
description: A veteran detective and a rookie cop have to stop a master thief's computer virus before it drains all the funds from a bank's accounts.

title: Wild Card
description: When a Las Vegas bodyguard with lethal skills and a gambling problem gets in trouble with the mob, he has one last play and it's all or nothing.

title: The Last Stand
description: Retirement is for sissies.

title: Killing Them Softly
description: After a rival crook hires a pair of bumbling thieves (Scoot McNairy, Ben Mendelsohn) to rob their card game, mobsters hire a reluctant hit man (Brad Pitt) to settle the score.

title: The Asian Connection
description: Two American expats, Jack and Sam, become the targets of a Southeast Asian gang's vengeance when they unwittingly steal a drug lord's money.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E03 — Attack of the 50 ft. Sex Machine
Richie and Santanico pose as sex traffickers to infiltrate Malvado's food supply, while Sonja forces Seth to kick his drug habit. Meanwhile, Freddie faces off with Sex Machine.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E04 — The Best Little Horror House In Texas
Kate hunts down Scott in Bethel; Richie and Santanico find themselves deep in the flesh trade; Seth tries to get back on Uncle Eddie's good side.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E07 — Directors in Action
Bola's new attitude is tested as she encounters more filming hurtles; the cast gets surprise visits from Robert Rodriguez when he drops by their sets to see their work.

title: Ring of Fire
description: Cross-town lovers (Don "The Dragon" Wilson, Maria Ford) fuel the rivalry between Los Angeles kickboxing clubs, leading to a showdown.

title: Ring of Fire II: Blood and Steel
description: Los Angeles thugs kidnap a doctor's (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) girlfriend and force him into a kickboxing ring of death.

title: Ring of Fire 3: Lion Strike
description: His son's (Jonathon Wilson) kidnapping pits a doctor (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) against a global underworld.

title: The Delta Force
description: Terrorists reroute a passenger jet from Athens to Beirut, where commandos (Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin) are waiting to negotiate.

title: The Substitute
description: A soldier of fortune (Tom Berenger) fills in for an injured teacher (Diane Venora) in a high school where gangs rule and the principal (Ernie Hudson) has a piece of the action.

title: The Substitute 2: School's Out
description: To avenge his brother's death, a mercenary works undercover as a teacher at a tough high school.

title: The Substitute 3: Winner Takes All
description: A former mercenary (Treat Williams) becomes an undercover professor as he tries to track down the person who attacked an old Army buddy's daughter.

title: The Substitute 4: Failure Is Not an Option
description: An undercover policeman infiltrates a military school's faculty to put a stop to the actions of white supremacists.

title: Machete Kills
description: The president recruits ex-Federale Machete to take down an eccentric arms dealer who plans to spread war and anarchy throughout the world.

title: Black Christmas
description: Sorority sisters (Olivia Hussey, Margot Kidder) and their drunken housemother fall prey to an obscene yuletide caller.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E06 — Filmmaking Isn't Easy
BK clashes with her director of photography as the two struggle to share a vision; Bola loses locations and her patience while trying to balance being on a reality show and being a director at the same time.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
Wrapping Up & Looking Back
Robert Rodriguez invites five amateur filmmakers to take on the same challenge he did 25 years ago with his first film -- to write, shoot and edit a brand-new feature length film with only $7,000.

title: The Director's Chair
description:
S02 E02 — Frank Darabont
Director Frank Darabont and host Robert Rodriguez talk about getting started in the movie industry.

title: The Stepfather
description: A Pacific Northwest teen (Jill Schoelen) suspects that her mother's (Shelley Hack) smiling new husband (Terry O'Quinn) is not what he appears to be.

title: Stepfather 2: Make Room for Daddy
description: An asylum-escaped killer (Terry O'Quinn) poses as a family therapist and seduces his next-door neighbor (Meg Foster).

title: The Boondock Saints
description: Two brothers (Sean Patrick Flanery, Norman Reedus), believing themselves to be on a mission from God, begin killing members of Boston's underworld.

title: Acts of Violence
description: A man teams up with his ex-military brothers and a detective to save his kidnapped fiancée from human traffickers.

title: 24 Hours to Live
description: After a mercenary dies in a brutal firefight, a new regenerative surgery gives him a second chance at life and another shot at redemption.

title: The Foreigner
description: A businessman embarks on a revenge-fueled vendetta after his daughter dies in a terrorist bombing. His search leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

title: Punisher: War Zone
description: Frank Castle, known as the Punisher, ruthlessly demolishes organized crime, but it starts an even bigger war.

title: Dog Soldiers
description: A pack of werewolves targets a squad of soldiers (Sean Pertwee, Kevin McKidd) on a training exercise in the Scottish Highlands.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E01 — Meet the Filmmakers
Five first-time filmmakers are thrust into the world of pre-production and tasked with choosing locations; an alluring location leaves one filmmaker considering rewriting his entire script.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E06 — Bizarre Tales
Freddie and Kate follow the trail of a mass grave to Oculto, a reclusive and dangerous Lord.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E07 — Bring Me the Head of Santanico Pandemonium
Richie and Seth hatch a plan to complete Santanico's revenge; Freddie and Kate face an unexpected foe.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E08 — The Last Temptation Of Richard Gecko
The uneasy truce between brothers and partners falls apart in light of new betrayals.

title: Missing in Action
description: A U.S. colonel (Chuck Norris) escapes from the Viet Cong, then comes back with a floating arsenal to get others out.

title: Missing in Action 2: The Beginning
description: An imprisoned U.S. colonel (Chuck Norris) fights the military overlord (Oh Soon-tek) of a slave-labor opium operation in Vietnam.

title: Braddock: Missing in Action III
description: A U.S. colonel (Chuck Norris) returns to Vietnam and fights his way out with his wife, son (Roland Harrah III) and Amerasian orphans.

title: The Asian Connection
description: Two American expats, Jack and Sam, become the targets of a Southeast Asian gang's vengeance when they unwittingly steal a drug lord's money.

title: Swelter
description: Ten years after their casino heist, four escaped convicts trace their former partner to a desert town, where he is now a lawman with no memory of his criminal past.

title: Prisoner of War
description: Captured by Japanese forces during World War II, a British SAS officer and his fellow prisoners are forced to fight in brutal death matches for the entertainment of their captors.
